title: Linden Meridian
description: An E-flat neighbour first bends a D-minor song and resolves immediately. It returns with increasing weight until the bass claims it, opening a path through E-flat seventh into A-flat. The song does not go home: its opening gesture finds a quieter belonging in the new key.
technical_note: Distinguish the early E-flat neighbour from its later harmonic arrivals. Shape the through-composed melody without treating each bass change as a new beginning. Let the low-voice entries speak gently beneath the held upper notes, and keep the final A-flat phrase in tempo.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
